描述_EN: when they were accidentally unearthed centuries later they became treasured objects of antiquarian scholars and collectors. each vessel had a specific name according to its shape and function. in ancient china metalworkers made a great variety of food and wine containers in bronze for ritual use. this bronze wine jar is called a 'hu' in chinese. these vessels were buried with the dead.
描述_ZN: 当他们在几个世纪后被意外发掘出来时，他们成为了古董学者和收藏家的珍品。 每个容器根据其形状和功能都有一个特定的名字。 在古代中国，金属工人用青铜制造了大量的食物和酒的容器，供祭祀使用。 这个青铜酒罐在中国被称为 "胡"。 这些器皿与死者埋在一起。
